name: Text Classification (Naive Bayes on a document-term matrix)
when_to_use: Supervised classification of sentiment/category (e.g., positive/negative) with labeled data; binary categorical dependent variable; requires a clean corpus (stopwords, stemming) and a sparse document-term matrix.

expected_input.question: How to classify documents with a probabilistic model?

plain_explanation.purpose: Classifies texts into categories by learning from already labeled examples.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When there are texts with a known category and you want to classify the new ones.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A text column and a column with the correct category, with a reasonable volume of examples.
plain_explanation.example: Classify an expense description by type.
plain_explanation.diagram: words of the text -> chance of each category -> the highest wins
